{{Quote|Rendezvous point?''"<br />"''Go about and follow me to Vorpa'ya.|[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="APM" />}}
'''Vorpa'ya''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located within the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector's]] [[Vorpa'ya system/Legends|Vorpa'ya system]],<ref name="TEAOC" /> not far from the neighboring world of [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. A terrestrial planet with a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="APM" /> Vorpa'ya was conquered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and became part of Mandalorian [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Blanketed in [[Grass/Legends|grass]] plains, Vorpa'ya became the home of numerous [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]]. However, as [[Time/Legends|time]] went by and the [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerf owners]] allowed their livestock to overgraze, the land degraded. By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], simply landing a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the plains of Vorpa'ya would kick up large clouds of gritty dust. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kubariet]] met with [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on Vorpa'ya to trade intelligence in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="APM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vorpa'ya first appeared in the [[EBook|e-novella]] ''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].
